audit.whatIsWrong: content win[2] through win[5] read Skill, Skill, Teemo, Skill, while whys[2] to whys[5] all describe Aatrox closing, pinning and deleting him. The packet chart gives Teemo only Levels 1-2 and Aatrox everything from Level 3.
audit.why: Teemo has no escape beyond Move Quick's speed, and Blinding Dart does nothing to The Darkin Blade — so from level 3, once Aatrox can reach him, his defensive kit is a 7s blind that only touches autos. 51.53% over 2616 games.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 stay Teemo; Level 3 onward all read Aatrox.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup as having no cooldown sequencing anywhere, and it is right — 'trade the moment you have E up' and 'time your all-in around the blind' give no numbers.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank and Move Quick a flat 14s. A 7s blind against a 5-9s Umbral Dash means you simply do not open your combo into a fresh Q — you eat it, then go.
audit.corrected: 7s Blinding Dart and 14s Move Quick written into spikes[0], spikes[3] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Blinding Dart as a general defensive tool ('his Q blind can't save him', 'his blind still blunts one auto window') without ever stating its actual scope: it blinds basic attacks only. The Darkin Blade, Infernal Chains and Umbral Dash all land through it untouched. What it does cost you is Deathbringer Stance — the empowered auto and its heal.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.' Blind is a basic-attack effect. The mirror at audits/top/teemo__aatrox.json documents the same error running the other way — that file claimed the blind cancels Aatrox's Q. Stated correctly, the rule is simple: when you are blinded, keep casting and stop auto-attacking, and do not waste a Deathbringer Stance proc into it.
audit.corrected: Blind scoped to basic attacks and Deathbringer Stance in spikes[0], mid and late; ability damage explicitly still landing.

audit.whatIsWrong: late tells you to buy 'tenacity and MR' but nothing explains why MR is the priority.
audit.why: Toxic Shot is an on-hit poison that keeps ticking for four seconds after each attack, so his damage scales with attack speed and is magic — armour reads the trade completely wrong. That is also why his chip continues after you break away.
audit.corrected: Toxic Shot named as the on-hit magic poison in late.

edits.before: Your combo comes online: E charges let you close, and a Q3 knockup + W pull locks him in place where his Q blind can't save him. Trade the moment you have E up and drain through his squishy frame.
edits.after: Your combo comes online: E charges let you close, and Q3 knockup into chains pins him. Blinding Dart (7s) stops basic attacks only — your Q, W and E all land through it, so eat the blind, then trade.

edits.before: Level 3 flips the lane to you. With E charges you finally close the gap, and a Q3 knockup + W Infernal Chains pins him where the blind can't help — a squishy Teemo can't survive your drain once you're on him. His R Noxious Trap carpets the lane by 6, so sweep or path around shrooms before you commit, but with your combo online every misstep of his is a kill. Force trades the instant your E is up and drain through his fragile frame.
edits.after: Level 3 flips the lane to you. With E charges you close the gap, and Q3 knockup into Infernal Chains pins him. Blinding Dart only blinds basic attacks — every ability you own still lands — so the real cost is a wasted Deathbringer Stance proc and its heal. Eat the 7s dart, then commit. Noxious Trap carpets the lane by 6, so sweep before you step, but once you are on a squishy Teemo he dies.

edits.before: You keep the lead into the late game. With tenacity, MR, and your item spike you shrug off his ramping poke and close the gap his kiting relied on, and your R World Ender heal amp punishes any single misposition hard. Sweep his shrooms before you commit and look to fight him where he can't run forever. His blind still blunts one auto window, so time your all-in around it — but the raw brawl is yours whenever you land W.
edits.after: You keep the lead into the late game. Buy MR, not armour: Toxic Shot is an on-hit magic poison that keeps ticking for four seconds after every attack, so his damage rides his attack speed rather than his AD. Tenacity and your item spike close the gap his kiting relied on. Sweep shrooms before you step, and open your combo after the 7s Blinding Dart rather than into it — your abilities land regardless.

edits.before: Q blind your autos to negate Deathbringer procs early
edits.after: Blind your autos so Deathbringer Stance is wasted

edits.before: Teemo changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Teemo blind, move speed, and shrooms. Aatrox wins by controlling spacing with his first two Q swings, holding E until the enemy punish tool is committed, and managing the wave so the enemy must walk into the outer edge of his Q. Teemo wants to keep distance, poke Aatrox before he can reach the wave, and punish missed Qs with ranged damage or crowd control.
edits.after: Teemo changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect a 7s Blinding Dart that stops basic attacks and the Deathbringer Stance heal but never touches his abilities, plus Move Quick (14s) and a shroom carpet. Aatrox wins by eating the dart and casting straight through it: Darkin Blade spacing, Infernal Chains onto the pin, and MR over armour against the on-hit poison of Toxic Shot.

edits.after: Blind hits autos only, not spells

Riot's World Ender text says nothing about revealing anything — it fears minions and grants AD, healing and Move Speed.
